card.name: Time units after a number or frequency
card.fires_on: Time-unit words such as week, weekly, hours and weeks that close a duration or frequency phrase. Typical settings are exercise schedules and dosing or monitoring times, such as 'per week' or 'for 48 hours'.

modes.description: Week or weekly ending a how-often phrase in study descriptions.

modes.description: The word hours following a number like 24 or 48 in a duration or time-point.
